boundary_decision.rationale: The subject spans multiple separately identifiable request, supply, exposure and reported-use records whose relationships form the useful whole, so aggregate is more accurate than event. The frozen record_plane is world-model and catalogue entry_kind is standalone-mm; neither is the subject-schema entry_kind axis. Every constituent retains its own event or request semantics.

decisions.concept: Request, dispense, administration and statement separation
decisions.rationale: FHIR defines intent, supply, actual exposure and reported belief as distinct records. The aggregate composes them through references and independent child identities rather than flattening them into one status or event.

decisions.concept: Prescribed, dispensed and actually administered dosage separation
decisions.rationale: Dose, timing, route, site, method, rate, instructions, product and quantity may differ across stages. Source-qualified differences and reasons must survive reconciliation and projection.

decisions.concept: Medication and regulated product master ownership
decisions.rationale: IDMP, SNOMED CT, RxNorm and FHIR separate product and terminology knowledge from patient-specific lifecycle records. The aggregate binds versioned substance, product, pack and lot identities but does not own their lifecycle.

A MedicationStatement is weaker reported or derived evidence, while WHO transition guidance supports attributable source comparison, discrepancy resolution, list update and communication. Neither is silently promoted to formal administration evidence.

decisions.concept: Medication safety checks and clinical authority
decisions.rationale: High-risk controls, allergy, contraindication, interaction and duplicate-therapy checks are relevant evidence, but knowledge versions, reviewer authority, local policy, override and escalation remain external and profile-specific.

Cancelling or stopping a request does not retroactively cancel completed dispense or administration events. Released records are corrected through linked successors, preserving prior status, actual values and provenance.

The registry ledger records Care Plan / Episode CONTAINS WM-ACT-048 as candidate metadata. The specification may reference plan context but may not publish this edge as approved or infer lifecycle cascade.

decisions.concept: Standards maturity, regional scope and analytic projection
decisions.rationale: FHIR R5 medication resources are Trial Use at varied maturity, EMA IDMP and RxNorm have regional implementation scope, and OMOP may combine source event kinds analytically. Every mapping must pin versions, provenance, units and information loss.

One Claude Sonnet and one Grok 4.6 research attempt each timed out after 120 seconds, and the separate external no-tools adjudicator timed out after 90 seconds. The frozen Codex result was then audited locally without new research facts. Confidence remains medium and assurance remains reviewable-draft.
